canon_ref.note: The walk takes Erin about an hour, not the twenty minutes Relc claimed. Gate guard named Belsc in 1.12.

b1.erin_walks_to_liscor.summary: Out of food and clean clothes, Erin walks to Liscor with her coins, throwing stones at Goblins who trail her. A bored yellow-scaled Drake at the east gate waves her in: anyone may enter, and the gates shut at sundown. She is the only Human in a crowded Drake and Gnoll city.

b1.erin_meets_selys.summary: Lost and unable to read Drake script, Erin wanders into the Adventurer's Guild. Selys, the Drake receptionist, is friendly and points her to the market. A tired Gnoll adventurer, back from a Shield Spider bounty, says she stinks and pushes her out.

system.name: Cannot read Drake script
system.note: Everyone speaks a language she understands, but she cannot read signs.
